requirement: The system shall raise an alert when soil moisture falls below the configured minimum threshold for a field.
The system shall compute the average soil moisture for a field over a chosen period, ignoring readings flagged as faulty.
The farmer opens the dashboard; the system displays the latest reading for each sensor in each field, ordered by field name.
A sensor reading is received; the system validates that the value falls within the sensor's physical range, records it and updates the latest-reading cache.
As a farm manager, I want to compare soil moisture across all fields in a selected period so that I can prioritise irrigation.
As a farmer, I want to set the minimum and maximum thresholds for a sensor so that alerts fire only within my chosen range.
A field shall not be able to have a sensor assigned if the sensor is already assigned to a different field.
Every configuration change (threshold, schedule, sensor assignment) must be recorded with the old value, the new value, the actor and the time.
The sensor reading table shall ensure that a reading's value is within the sensor's physical range and that a reading cannot be recorded more than five minutes in the future.
code:
-- sensor reading table
CREATE TABLE sensor_reading (
    reading_id       BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    sensor_id        VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    kind             VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL,
    value            NUMERIC(10,3) NOT NULL,
    reported_at      TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    faulty           BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    fault_reason     VARCHAR(200),
    CONSTRAINT reading_sensor_fk FOREIGN KEY (sensor_id) REFERENCES sensor(sensor_id),
    CONSTRAINT reading_kind_chk  CHECK (kind IN ('SOIL_MOISTURE','SOIL_TEMPERATURE','HUMIDITY','RAINFALL','WIND_SPEED')),
    CONSTRAINT reading_reported_not_future CHECK (reported_at <= now() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'),
    CONSTRAINT reading_value_reasonable CHECK (value BETWEEN -100 AND 1000)
);

CREATE INDEX reading_sensor_time_idx ON sensor_reading (sensor_id, reported_at DESC);
hard_negatives:
-- sensor master table
CREATE TABLE sensor (
    sensor_id      VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
    farm_id        VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    field_id       VARCHAR(40),
    kind           VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    min_value      NUMERIC(10,3) NOT NULL,
    max_value      NUMERIC(10,3) NOT NULL,
    installed_at   TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT sensor_range_order CHECK (max_value > min_value)
);
-- threshold configuration table
CREATE TABLE threshold (
    threshold_id  BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    field_id      VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    sensor_kind   VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL,
    min_value     NUMERIC(10,3) NOT NULL,
    max_value     NUMERIC(10,3) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT threshold_unique UNIQUE (field_id, sensor_kind),
    CONSTRAINT threshold_range_order CHECK (max_value > min_value)
);

requirement: Only a farm manager or an administrator may change thresholds or schedules; field workers may only view readings and alerts.
The nightly aggregation job shall produce a per-field daily summary of minimum, maximum and average soil moisture, excluding faulty readings.
